card.name: Start of a unit or name after a number
card.fires_on: The first piece of a unit or compound name right after a number or digit, such as the m in 1,000 mcL, the S in Sr 85/Sr 82, or the B in OATP1B1/3. It also fires on the slash in a fraction like 266/1008.

modes.label: Micro unit after count
modes.description: The m of mcL or microliter right after a blood-count number.

modes.label: Isotope or ratio pairing
modes.description: The second item of a pair joined to the first, such as Sr 85 and Sr 82 or PD-1 and PD-L1.

modes.label: Numeric gene or fraction joiner
modes.description: A letter or slash joining numbered items, as in OATP1B1/3 or a count fraction.
